purpose: Decide whether the weak existing 22-feature late-q result is an architecture/data-optimization ceiling or a missing-information ceiling, before paying to generate signed-pair actions.
scientific_scope: This is an observer-fit capacity discriminator, not a deployable D4 score estimate.  It rebuilds J fold-pure, fits no inference truth feature, opens no observer-selection/name/score/board surface, and grants no submission authority.

role_and_firewall.transaction: exactly one run; an O_CREAT|O_EXCL file-and-directory-fsynced claim is written after target-free row verification and before target decode; no retry after claim; any post-claim exception writes a terminal O_EXCL failure receipt

fold_law.algorithm: sort role ranks by (blake2s-128(salt+':'+mlp_id),mlp_id,role_rank), assign sorted position modulo 4

fold_pure_j.fit: rebuild once per outer fold on exactly its 516 fit rows
fold_pure_j.architecture: 36->96 SiLU->96 SiLU, four recurrent channels, corrected layers 2:15
fold_pure_j.normalizers: raw centers/scales and target layer RMS computed from the 516 fit rows only using frozen raw sufficient statistics and target errors
fold_pure_j.optimizer: AdamW lr=0.0012, eta_min=0.0001, weight_decay=0.00002, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, fixed source penalties from bound source
fold_pure_j.row_order: PCG64(1753358438 xor fold*0x9E3779B1), one permutation of increasing fit ranks per epoch

features.law: the exact prior q-head feature law: raw20 channel0; fold-fit standardized raw20 channels1:19; foldJ state divided by fold-J layer RMS; qJ divided by sigma times fold-J layer RMS; all standardized quantities clipped to [-8,8]

paired_models.control: 22->64 SiLU->64 SiLU plus six zero-initialized scalar heads
paired_models.shared256_diagnostic: one shared 22->256 SiLU->256 SiLU->256 SiLU trunk plus six zero-initialized scalar heads
paired_models.primary_capacity_arm: six independent 22->256 SiLU->256 SiLU->256 SiLU trunks, one per suffix layer, each with its own zero-initialized scalar head; this arm alone determines the capacity verdict
paired_models.data: all 1024 nodes at every suffix layer in every epoch; no node sampling
paired_models.row_order: PCG64(1362178069 xor 0xA5A5A5A5 xor fold*0x9E3779B1), one permutation of increasing fit ranks per epoch; byte-identical control/shared256/independent256 orders
paired_models.optimizer: AdamW lr=0.0012, weight_decay=0.00002, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8; CosineAnnealingLR T_max=1677 eta_min=0.0001; L2 gradient clip5
paired_models.loss: mean over six layers of full-node MSE(predicted_q,q_target)/fit-fold_q_rms_l^2

metrics.primary_endpoint: pooled held exact teacher-local suffix-transport final MSE

fixed_gate.heuristic_note: The local threshold comes from scaling the old 5.435490771826353e-9 local MSE by the 0.25306730196702215 allowed endpoint-excess fraction.  The exact endpoint threshold is independently conjunctive, so this heuristic is never used as proof by itself.

outcomes.mixed_local_pass_endpoint_fail: OPEN_Q3_STATE_OR_SUFFIX_UPDATE_CHILD; do not expand pair information before recurrence attribution
outcomes.mixed_local_fail: INFORMATION_OR_CONDITIONAL_MODEL_FAILURE; proceed to signed-pair H16 then H64/H256 ladder

runtime.rss: observational only for this accuracy discriminator; no deployment FLOP/RSS/residual gate can reject or prevent the scientific run
runtime.output_commit: MODELS.pt and RESULT.json are fsynced inside one temporary directory, then the directory is atomically renamed to NATIVE22_CAPACITY_OUTPUT_V1; no visible orphan model/result is permitted
